description:
Title: Chainsaw

You produce custom chainsaws on demand.
Your chainsaws have at least 5 properties such as length of the "guide bar" (Schwertlaenge), chain width, electric or motor chainsaw.
After your customer told you the properties, you can start ordering the parts from various online sources (in parallel).
After the parts arrive you have to do a manual inspection of all parts, and then assemble the parts.
During production, you regularly send updates to your customer.
After producing the first saw you send it to your customer.
If he likes it, the rest of his order are produced.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/chainsaw">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Properties" name="Chainsaw properties"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Update" name="Production update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FirstSaw" name="First chainsaw"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Feedback" name="Customer feedback"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Chainsaw">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Chainsaw producer" processRef="Process_Chainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Properties" name="Provides chainsaw properties" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Properties" messageRef="Message_Properties"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Updates" name="Sends production updates" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Update"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstSaw" name="Sends first chainsaw" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Provides feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Chainsaw" name="Chainsaw" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Properties" name="Customer provides chainsaw properties (at least five)">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Properties" messageRef="Message_Properties"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order parts from various online sources">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics id="LoopCharacteristics_OrderParts" isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_InspectParts" name="Manually inspect all parts"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit" name="Produce and send updates in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleFirstSaw" name="Assemble parts into the first chainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFirstSaw" name="Send first chainsaw to customer" messageRef="Message_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFeedback" name="Receive customer's feedback on first chainsaw" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LikesFirstSaw" name="Does the customer like the first chainsaw?" default="Flow_NotLiked"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceRemaining" name="Produce the remaining chainsaws in the order"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ProductionMerge" name="Continue after first-saw decision"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdates" name="Send production updates regularly" messageRef="Message_Update">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics id="LoopCharacteristics_SendUpdates" testBefore="false">
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Production is still in progress</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesJoin" name="Production and updates complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderComplete" name="Order production complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_OrderParts" sourceRef="StartEvent_Properties" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderParts_Inspect" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Task_InspectParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_Split" sourceRef="Task_InspectParts" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Assemble" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_AssembleFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Updates" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assemble_SendFirst" sourceRef="Task_AssembleFirstSaw" targetRef="Task_SendFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendFirst_ReceiveFeedback" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveFeedback_Likes" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_LikesFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Liked_ProduceRemaining" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_LikesFirstSaw" targetRef="Task_ProduceRemaining">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Customer likes the first chainsaw</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotLiked" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_LikesFirstSaw" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProduceRemaining_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRemaining" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Updates_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
